title: Ex-Dividend Date Insight: DNP Select Income Fund
description:
On March 8, 2021, DNP Select Income Fund (NYSE:DNP) announced shareholders can expect to receive a dividend payable on July 12, 2021. The stock will then go ex-dividend 1 business day(s) before the record date. The ex-dividend date for DNP Select Income Fund will be on June 29, 2021. The company's current dividend payout is at $0.07. That equates to a dividend yield of 7.68% at current price levels.
